in_hebrew.name: Morgun
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Morgun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse 'morgunr', meaning 'morning'. In Norse mythology, Morgun is the personification of the dawn.

in_greek.name: Morgun
in_greek.long_meaning: Morgun είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old Norse 'morgunr', meaning 'morning'. In Norse mythology, Morgun is the personification of the dawn.

in_latin.name: Morgun
in_latin.long_meaning: Morgun est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old Norse 'morgunr', meaning 'morning'. In Norse mythology, Morgun is the personification of the dawn.
